items.quote: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
items.claim: The finished tabernacle was brought to Moses, including the tent and its structural parts (taches, boards, bars, pillars, sockets).
items.object: the tabernacle, tent, and its structural furniture

items.quote: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,
items.claim: The tabernacle's coverings (red-dyed rams' skins, badgers' skins) and the vail of the covering were among the items brought to Moses.

items.quote: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
items.claim: The ark of the testimony, its staves, and the mercy seat were among the items brought to Moses.
items.object: ark of the testimony, staves, mercy seat

items.quote: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
items.claim: The table, its vessels, and the shewbread were among the items brought to Moses.

items.quote: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
items.claim: The pure candlestick with its lamps, vessels, and oil for light were among the items brought to Moses.
items.object: candlestick, lamps, vessels, oil for light

items.quote: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
items.claim: The golden altar, anointing oil, sweet incense, and the door hanging of the tabernacle were among the items brought to Moses.
items.object: golden altar, anointing oil, sweet incense, door hanging

items.quote: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
items.claim: The brass altar with its grate, staves, and vessels, plus the laver and its foot, were among the items brought to Moses.
items.object: brasen altar, grate, staves, vessels, laver and foot

items.quote: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
items.claim: The court hangings, pillars, sockets, gate hanging, cords, pins, and all service vessels for the tent of the congregation were among the items brought to Moses.
items.object: court hangings and fittings, service vessels

items.quote: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.
items.claim: The service cloths for the holy place and the holy garments for Aaron and his sons, for serving as priests, were among the items brought to Moses.
items.object: cloths of service; holy garments for Aaron and his sons
items.mechanism: garments made so Aaron and his sons could serve as priests
